_comment: The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime is a prerequisite, not part of ModularCV Desktop. Read by the sidecar tests and by the licence tests; src/vcruntime.rs and src-tauri/windows/hooks.nsh carry the same minimum, and a test keeps them equal.

prerequisite.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64)
prerequisite.minimum_reason: python314.dll and the extension modules record the MSVC toolset 14.44.35229 in their headers; Microsoft asks for a Redistributable at least as recent as the build tools
prerequisite.needed_by: python314.dll, libcrypto-3.dll, libssl-3.dll and the extension modules of the embedded engine (import of vcruntime140.dll)

not_shipped_reason: Microsoft distributes its Redistributable itself and Windows 10 and 11 provide the Universal CRT; ModularCV does not redistribute these files
